Markup-fidelity fixture for the PARAGRAPH typography component (svelte typography/Paragraph.svelte, keen Typography.paragraph/1). As of core 3.3.0-rc06 the old `.pa-text` BEM component is GONE — paragraphs now compose the flat `text-*` typography utilities (utilities.scss / snippets/typography.html) on a plain `

`. There is NO block/element/modifier structure: a paragraph with no props is a bare `

` at the body default (16px); each prop adds one flat utility class. Size/align/semantic map 1:1 to `text-{value}`; colour is irregular (primary → text-body = default body colour, secondary → text-secondary = muted). See label.json for a real BEM flat-element-with-modifiers component by contrast.

propsVocabulary.size:
size modifier xs|sm|lg|xl (default unset = 16px body default, bare

) → text-{value}
propsVocabulary.color: colour modifier primary|secondary → text-body (primary = default body colour) | text-secondary (muted). Irregular map, so not a {value} template.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (class passthrough — not a core feature)

goldenConventions:
Structural only. Base is a plain `

` with NO class when no prop is set; each set prop appends one flat `text-*` utility. Slot content is a plain text token so the diff checks tag + class + nesting, not rich content. Class-token order + whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. size/align/semantic use the uniform `text-{value}` template (capability.mjs expands + phantom-checks each against main.css). `color` produces null because its map is irregular (primary → text-body, NOT text-primary; secondary → text-secondary) — the two classes are instead exercised by the color-* scenario goldens. The `text` block matches no `text--*`/`text__*` in CSS (flat utilities, not BEM), so the capability gate emits a harmless advisory 'matched 0' note — expected for a utility-composed component.

color.note: primary → text-body (default body colour), secondary → text-secondary (muted); exercised by color-* goldens

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: No JS-toggled state classes — every text-* utility is feature-driven.

scenarios.name: default
scenarios.note:
Unmodified paragraph — a bare

at the 16px body default, no class.

scenarios.name: color-primary
scenarios.note: color="primary" maps to the default body colour utility text-body (NOT text-primary, which is the accent).

scenarios.name: combined
scenarios.note: Stacks align + colour + size; class-token order is normalized away.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough appended after the component classes.
